label: app-supervision
info: Fragment specific to the energy supervision deployment (spec supervision-energetique-spec-fonctionnelle.md). Two workstreams: (1) signed browser proxy POST /app/query — fap-light spec C1.9 / D-8 / CA-S10, front spec contract §9 ; (2) feed back to the FAP via app.outbox — RG-3 (fap-ldp spec §5.3). Concatenated with the core flows + fap-ldp.json by scripts/assemble-flows.sh.

name: OIDC session required + rate limit 60/min/user (C1.9)
check PDP (org framework contract) + HMAC signature D-3 server-side
audit dsp_access_audit + response as-is
read pending app.outbox → gate_ingest (gate role) → set processed_at
OIDC session required + rate limit 10/min/user (CR-5)
check session + asset whitelist (synchronous)
prepare internal LDP GET of the asset (user token → ACL/RLS)
audit dsp.audit + assemble context + 503 if no LLM_ENDPOINT
